description: This file handles HTTP requests related to OpenAI models, including authorization, listing models, and retrieving specific model details.

methods.name: toOpenAiModel
methods.description: Converts a model ID string into an OpenAiModelObject with preset properties.

methods.name: authorizeRequest
methods.description: Authorizes an incoming HTTP request using gateway authorization logic.

methods.name: loadAgentModelIds
methods.description: Loads and returns a list of model IDs including default and agent-specific models.

methods.name: resolveRequestPath
methods.description: Resolves the request URL path from the IncomingMessage object.
